text: 下面进入大作文 01 · 个人品质母题：坚持不懈与直面逆境，英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【首段 · 物称对比+让步】不要用 We can see two people。用 cartoon vividly depicts 开头，再用 Simple as... may seem 点明坚持主旨：
The thought-provoking cartoon vividly depicts two climbers scaling a steep mountain. Simple as the drawing may seem, it underscores the vital significance of perseverance on our path to success.
手术刀点拨：物称主语 + scaling 分词树状挂载 + 让步微调倒装，三句干净突破 55 词首段。
【二段 · 物称+anything but】改写“坚持让人克服困难，成功之路并不轻松”：
Unyielding perseverance empowers ordinary individuals to conquer severe obstacles, whereas the road to excellence is anything but smooth.
手术刀点拨：让“毅力”作主语搭配 empowers，后接 anything but smooth 替掉 is not easy。
【二段对比 + 尾段收官】用 whereas 对比“坚持目标 vs 沉溺借口”，再用 Only when 压轴：

Those who adhere to their goals tend to reap rewarding outcomes, while people indulging in excuses fail to fulfill their potential. Only when we persist through difficulties can we turn our ambitions into reality.
手术刀点拨：adhere to / indulge in / fail to / Only when ... can we 四重信号一次集齐。
